(rule! (let ((dummy 0))
  (define dirs4 (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
  (define (outline-cells cells)
    (filter (lambda (p)
      (any? (lambda (d)
        (not (member? (list (+ (first p) (first d))
                            (+ (second p) (second d)))
                      cells)))
        dirs4))
      cells))
  (define ranked
    (reverse (sort-by (objects g 0) (lambda (obj) (obj-size obj)))))
  (define selected (first ranked))
  (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
               (outline-cells (obj-cells selected))
               (obj-color selected))))
